description.value: Discovery Coffee is a locally owned Victoria roaster and cafe that began with a love of the craft and has grown into a multi-location operation with a devoted following. They roast all their beans in Victoria and offer house blends alongside single-origin coffees, with a partnership with Yonni's Doughnuts rounding out the food offering. The Menzies Street location puts touring cyclists close to the Inner Harbour and James Bay neighbourhoods.
